rules.label: edits › ease notch
rules.reason: N516 and N47 agree that the bowl's terminal meets the bar at a hairline, with a white notch running almost into the eye. The hairline (about 34 units) matches the face's other bowl joins and is kept; the notch's inner end, narrower than about 30 units, is closed so that the eye reads as closed at text sizes. The notch's mouth is kept.

rules.label: finishing › heights
rules.reason: Judged. The prints set letters of one row up to two source pixels (about 12 units) above or below one another (N516's x-height letters measure 489 to 523 units, its flat capitals 687 to 716), and the production sheet's H, F and D sit up to 19 units under its K and L. In a font these read as letters jumping off the line. Each listed letter is scaled about its baseline so that its flat tops (serifs, bars) meet the line and its round or domed tops the overshoot; the rest of the letter keeps its proportions, and what the prints show as drawn (o's and O's tall tilted ovals, the r's high bowl, the flags of t, T, D.alt1 and S.alt1, X's raised accent, the short descenders of f and j) keeps its height above its own line.

rules.label: finishing › stems
rules.reason: Noise. At N516's resolution a source pixel is about 6 units, and the straight stems measured 108 to 119 units (lowercase) and 121 to 139 (capitals) at random, with no pattern a pen or a drawing hand would make. Each is given the face's mean weight by moving its two edges apart or together, by at most 3 units each, so the letters' widths and joins stay where the prints put them.

rules.label: finishing › kerning
rules.reason: Judged, in text. The builder kerns a pair only where its closest approach is wide, which set quotes onto the shoulders of the next lowercase letter (m’athair, ‘an’: up to -140 units) and a hyphen into c's mouth (-115); those are eased to -40 and -30. Pairs whose white, measured across the x-height (cap height between capitals), exceeds that of n n, H H or H n by more than 12 units are closed by 60% of the excess, at most 60 units: chiefly l and L with their feet, F, V, K, X, Z, P and T before lowercase, and L, F, A with V, T, Y. Collision protection runs after.

rules.label: finishing › kerning › limits
rules.reason: Judged, in text (second pass). "*lower" is every lowercase letter, its alternates and its accented forms: the builder's exceptions for accented letters that stick out of their base's class kept the quotes' old kerning there (’â -110, ’ê -75, the quote touching the circumflex) while ’a was eased.

rules.label: finishing › kerning › clearances
rules.reason: Judged. The fada of í overhangs the i's side bearing (its ink starts at -36) and ran within 9 to 14 units of the capital before it (Sí, Cí, Rí, Pí, Fí), against 35 for Ní and Mí; kerning, not a moved fada, keeps the fada over its stem, so every glyph before an accented i keeps 40 units from its mark.

rules.label: finishing › kerning › clearances
rules.reason: Judged. The bold's wider pen took the white between capitals' arms and diagonals (A V 9 units after kerning, A W, A Y, T W, T Y, Z V, F V, V L 7 to 10) where the Regular's A V keeps 29: the bold's capitals keep 30, their class kerning eased or opened. Fourth pass: every style keeps it (the Regular's T Y kept 10, F V 11, T W 12, T I 13, the Italic's 11 to 18), and so does each accented capital, which its letter's class does not hold where its mark sticks out (the Bold's T Í 16 against T I 36, F Í 17, T Ĺ 17 against T L 37): an exception opens the pair.

rules.label: finishing › kerning › clearances
rules.reason: Judged (fourth pass). The optical kerning closes a capital's arm over the next letter's ascender (T h 12/13/14/10 in the four styles, F h 12, P i 17/10/13/10, the Bold's P m 9, P f 8, T b 8, V k 9, Z h 10), and the collision protection keeps only 8: a capital before a lowercase letter keeps 30, as between capitals, and so do their accented forms.

rules.label: finishing › kerning › clearances
rules.reason: Judged (final review). At 30 the bolds' capitals stood too far from an ascender: A l, T h, F h and F l opened from +20/+25 to +45 and A b, T b from +35 to +60, the white beside A l's diagonal more than between two l (the Bold's H l, two straight sides, keeps 43, the Regular's 69), so All, Abú and The were gappy at display sizes. The bolds' capitals before lowercase keep 20, two and a half times the collision protection's 8; between capitals they keep 30.

rules.label: finishing › bold pieces
rules.reason: Judged. The sheet's loose marks, rules and chevrons were read after the letters were bolded, so the bold's accents, dashes, math signs, guillemets, © and ° kept the Regular's outlines (acute stroke 61 against stems of 166, rules 60). Each piece is grown with the bold's pen (rx 24.2, ry 17.4): the dots, rules and chevrons by all of it, like the bold's i dot, period and horizontal strokes; the stroke accents by 0.72 of it, which keeps the Regular's proportion to the stems (acute 61 to 90, circumflex and tilde 54-57 to 81-83), the ring's hairline by 0.45 (32 to 49, its hole kept round); each pair is set apart again by the width the pen added. The rules come to 92 (the math signs with them), the ponc to 168 by 142 beside the i dot's 182 by 160.
rules.nums: share acute 0.72, circumflex 0.72, tilde 0.72, ring 0.45, dot 1, dieresis 1, endash 1, emdash 1, guil 1, pairs [dieresis.l, dieresis.r]; [guil.r1, guil.r2]; [guil.l1, guil.l2]

rules.label: finishing › bold joins
rules.reason: Judged. The bold's pen closes the drawn open joins of k, r, 6 and 9, and easing the aperture back took the pen off both sides of it: the stem narrowed from 166 to 146 in faceted steps and a 4 to 12-unit crack remained. The join is drawn closed and its gap taken from the terminal alone, 20 units wide (the sloped style's cut wider by its hair of weight, so it is 20 once sloped), the terminal's face one curve; the stem keeps its straight edge and its 166 units.

rules.label: finishing › g tail
rules.reason: Judged. In the bold the pen and the restored baseline raise the tip of g's tail 34 units, onto the bowl (opening 8 units in Bold, 4 in Bold Italic, 50 in the Regular): the tip is lowered 30 units, falling off along the tail within 170 units, so the opening is about 34 and the tail's foot stays on its line.

rules.label: finishing › symbols
rules.reason: Judged. The bold's section interlaced the bold s, which it had to lighten until its loop opened (stroke 96 against the bold s's 133, its foot raised from 66 to 122): it is drawn as the Regular's section with the bold's pen, in its own frame (66 to 700), as black as the bold s, its loop keeping half its area (a letter's least counter keeps 0.36), so that the sloped style's narrowing leaves it open. The bold's number sign, drawn at 0.85 of the rules, keeps the Regular's proportion to the stems (81 thinned to 75). Fourth pass: the pen narrowed the bold section's terminal openings to 14 and 26 units (the Regular's 36 and 54); each terminal is moved away from the stroke across its bay ("mouths": lower_tip, falling off within 200 units) until the opening is 32, the stroke keeping its edge.

rules.label: finishing › marks on line
rules.reason: Noise. A mark narrower than an open capital's counter (the ring on U) found the counter's floor under it (Ů's ring sat inside the U at 208 to 342): where a top mark would sit below 0.8 of its letter's line, the letter's top is found under the acute's wider window instead, so Ů's ring sits at 745 as Å's and Ú's marks do.

rules.label: finishing › corners
rules.reason: Noise. Where the section's two s meet, and at the corners the round offset of its s left, the outlines kept pieces of 2 to 5 units (a spur turning 122 degrees on 2 units in the Regular, facets in the bold): each run of pieces under 8 units at a corner is one node where the outline either side meets, a short piece along a smooth run is merged into a neighbour within 2.5 units, and a run of straight facets (an eased aperture's cut, traced as a polygon) is drawn as the curve it stands for, within 2 units; in a bold, also on the letters whose joins were cut (k, r, 6, 9, g) and their accented forms.
rules.nums: bold [k, r, six, nine, g], short 8, tolerance 2.5, facets 2

rules.label: finishing › bold curves
rules.reason: Noise (third pass). Where the curve fitter could not follow the bold's pen, its offset stayed a polygon and the outline clean-up kept it: in G, S, s, v, w, x, y, ß, W and the alternate g and y (47 glyphs a bold style, with their accented forms) curves ran as chains of two to nine straight facets 7 to 80 units long turning 3 to 34 degrees at each join, with pieces of 1 to 7 units at their corners. Each run of facets is fitted with cubics (curvefit.fit_cubics: nodes at its extremes, as few as draw it within 1.5 units of the polygon both ways, tangent to the outline either side where it joins smoothly), and each piece under 8 units is folded away, into a neighbour's curve, a corner's one node or a rounded corner, every node and the outline within 1.5 units of the outline as it was (a spur of 3 units in the Bold Italic's ß may go); a glyph whose pieces, counters or area (by 0.5%) would change is left as it was. The marks of the accented forms are treated with them; three keep one bevel of 5 to 7 units that no fold takes within 1.5 units (the Bold Italic's š caron and the comma below of Ģ and Ș), as every other letter's caron and comma below do.

rules.label: finishing › bold marks
rules.reason: Judged (third pass). The builder draws the cedilla and the ogonek (marks.MarkSet) with a stroke taken from the ring's width, and the bold's ring is a hairline grown by 0.45 of the pen, so they went only from 40 and 43 units in the Regular to 46 and 48 against the bold's acute of 90 and stems of 166. They are drawn as the Regular's and grown with the bold's pen by the stroke accents' share, 0.72, as bold_pieces grows the acute: 67 and 70 (70 and 73 in the Bold Italic), the weight of the bold's comma below (67). Font2.attach sets them by the neck as before, so they join their letters as before and the hook's white under the letter stays (ç 28 against the Regular's 26, ş 26 against 28, ą 33 against 33). Their hooks reach 20 units deeper (Ç to -194), so the family's line box grows at the foot from -190 to -204, as the second pass raised it for the bold's capital accents; the Regular and Italic change in their vertical metrics only.

rules.label: finishing › bold math
rules.reason: Judged (fourth pass). The bold drew its math signs with its rules (60 to 92 units) about the Regular's centres, so each piece grew towards its neighbour and make_symbols set them apart by its weight: = 142-202 and 280-340 became 88-181 and 301-394 (white 78 to 120), the underbar of ± -14..46 became -82..10, that of ≤ ≥ 38..98 became -31..62, the dots of ÷ stood 84 off the bar (54), the waves of ≈ 141 apart (97), and ~ and ^ grew upward only (190-352 to 190-396, 434-668 to 434-706). Each piece now grows about its own centre and the pieces are set apart again so the white between them is the Regular's: = 110-202 and 280-372 on the 241 axis; ± its underbar -30..62 (the Regular's foot less the pen's 17 is -31) and the plus raised 16; ≤ ≥ the bar 22..114 and the chevron raised 29, 41 units off it as in the Regular; ÷ its dots the bold's period made no taller than leaves the Regular's 54 of white within the Regular's extent and the pen's 17 (53..429); ≈ 96 apart; ~ 168-374 and ^ 415-687 about the Regular's centres. + − × < > ¬ were centred already, and ≠ follows =.

rules.label: finishing › bold small
rules.reason: Judged (fourth pass). The bold's bullet was the Regular's disc (174 units while the period grew from 107 to 159), and its small glyphs, drawn halfway to the Regular's weight so that their counters stay open, gained about 20 units of stem where the letters gain 52 (¹ 84 to 103, % 85 to 105, the a of @ 93 to 115). The bullet is now a disc as much larger than the Regular's as the bold's period is (261). The small glyphs are drawn as the Regular draws them (symbols.make_symbols, from the Regular's letters at the Regular's weight) with the bold's pen: % ‰ and the a, c and R inside @ © ® with all of it, their counters kept as the section's are (half their area, 0.66 of their radius), so they gain in the letters' proportion (the zeros of % 85 to 123, stems 114 to 166); the superiors, fractions, ordinals and ™ with the share of the pen that keeps their Regular proportion to the full-size figures (¹ 0.68 of the 1; 0.65 of the pen, ™ 0.5), their counters kept at 0.7 of their radius, at the heaviest share at which every opening keeps 0.65 of the Regular's (a closing measure, kilfane_studio.opening_fast; the 4 of ¼ and ¾ keeps 28 of 40). The rings of © ® @ are left for the family's pass.

rules.label: finishing › bold dots
rules.reason: Judged (fourth pass). The pen grows a dot and its stroke towards each other: the Bold's ! and ? kept 14 and 16 units (the Bold Italic's 12 and 15) against the Regular's 49 and 52, and read as solid strokes at 12 to 18 px, and the dots of i and j 25 and 21 against 62 and 57 (true distances; a vertex measure gives 41 and 37 against 75 and 71). The stroke of ! and ? now ends higher, its last 30 units moved whole and the 120 above them drawn shorter, until the white is the Regular's (¡ and ¿ are drawn from them); the Bold Italic is allowed 3 units more, for its slope's hair of weight (which is horizontal, so Céilí's 1.3 is not needed). The dot of i and j is raised by half of what it lacks and drawn smaller about its top by the other half, to 52 units clear (166 by 147, its top at 705 against 691). The j's hook, whose tip the pen and the restored heights raised above the baseline to +13 (under the n's foot, where the collision protection then opened n j by 40), has its tip lowered to -10, falling off along the hook within 120 units, as the second pass lowered the g's tail.

rules.label: finishing › spacing
rules.reason: Judged (fourth pass). The builder spaces a glyph on its outline across the x-height, depth limited, where j's hook and the bowl of ? reach further than the limit: the bold's j stood 60 units right of where i stands (advance 369 against 309, n j 191 against n i 146, with kerns of -15 to -25 making up for it), and ? stood 41 units closer than ! in the Regular (n ? 96 against n ! 137 at mid x-height) and 13 further in the Bold. One rule in every style, measured from 0.4 to 0.6 of the x-height: j's stem stands where i's does, with i's right side (the Bold's j: advance 309, left side -128), so the optical kerning adds none to j; ? stands on its stem as ! on its stroke, and ¿ as ¡.

rules.label: finishing › case
rules.reason: Judged (fourth pass). Kilfane has true capitals, but its hyphen, dashes, guillemets, middle dot, bullet and colon sit on the lowercase axis (241) against the capitals' middle (353), @ on the lowercase, and ¡ ¿ hang from the x-height. The case feature (OpenType case) takes case forms: each centred on the capitals' middle (the hyphen, dashes, guillemets, · and • raised 112, the colon 96, @ 138), and ¡ ¿ set over the line as ! and ? are (raised 157 and 167), spaced as their glyphs. Each joins its glyph's kerning classes; where, raised, it would come closer to a neighbour than its glyph does, an exception eases the pair by the difference, never past no kerning, never closer than the glyph, never within 8 units (the low hyphen tucks under F's arm at -110; the raised one, level with it, is not kerned). The parentheses, brackets, braces and bar already stand about the capitals' middle (356 to 366) and keep their glyphs.

rules.label: finishing › settle
rules.reason: Noise (fourth pass). Rounding the sheared outlines to whole units turned the short handles at stem and arch joins by about the slope (the Italic m's joins 8 to 11 degrees, the n's and h's 8), and the uprights kept joins their finishing could not turn within its tolerance (the Bold's section 6 to 10 degrees): 425 Italic and 432 Bold Italic glyphs had a near-smooth join (a curve on one side, bending 2 to 12 degrees once the slope is sheared off) left bent, 201 Regular and 338 Bold. Last of all, in every style, each such join is made smooth: its handles turned to the join's tangent on whole units (as settle.py settles Carrick's), each curve within 1.5 units, or else the curves either side drawn again on whole-unit handles leaving the join along that tangent, within 2, or a piece under 12 units beside it drawn as one curve with its neighbour; no curve may come to pass an extreme, a join the slope brings under 12 degrees from a corner of the upright stays a corner, and a glyph whose pieces or area would change is left as it was.

rules.label: fifth pass › approxequal
rules.reason: ≈ was two tildes stretched to the sign's width and 1.25 times their height: 362 tall (60..422) against the ='s 198 (142..340), its waves heavier than the bars (72 against 61) and 97 apart where the bars stand 78; in the Bold the fourth pass's ≈ (bold_math) kept those waves 96 apart, 433 tall against 263. Its waves are now drawn at the bars' weight (60, Italic 61, Bold 92, Bold Italic 93, against bars of 61 and 93 to 94), centred where the bars are on the 241 axis, 0.7 of the ='s white apart (55 against 78): 236 tall (123..359; Bold 304, 89..393)
